svg.title: Author use cases — proposed design
svg.desc: One author is associated with seven goals: enter story, submit a request, inspect progress or failure, inspect a ready result and simplifications, play and finish, browse versions, and deliberately regenerate a linked version. Associations do not imply execution order.

div.style: color: rgb(25, 51, 71) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Author
Writer, teacher or small-team member

div.style: color: rgb(25, 51, 71) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
UC-01 · Enter or edit story
Genre intent, goal and main action

div.style: color: rgb(25, 51, 71) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
UC-02 · Submit generation request
Obtain project/version/job IDs

div.style: color: rgb(25, 51, 71) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
UC-03 · Check progress or failure
Queued / generating / validating / ready / failed

div.style: color: rgb(25, 51, 71) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
UC-04 · Inspect ready result
Read simplifications and reasons

div.style: color: rgb(25, 51, 71) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
UC-05 · Preview, play, finish and replay
Selected immutable ready version only

div.style: color: rgb(25, 51, 71) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
UC-06 · Browse catalogue and versions
Find failures and earlier ready games

div.style: color: rgb(25, 51, 71) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
UC-07 · Edit, retry or regenerate
Create linked version; preserve predecessor
